resourceName: Hunan Miluo IFM (conversion of logged to protected forest) Project
description:
The Hunan Miluo IFM (conversion of logged to protected forest) Project (hereafter “the project activity”) is implemented in Miluo City, Hunan Province of China by Hunan Carbon Technology Co., Ltd. The geographic coordinate of project is 112°51′~113° 27′ E and 28°28′~29°27′ N, the total area is 156,200 ha, which includes the Improved Forest Management (IFM) of the forests in the conversion of logged to protected forest.

The area of the project activity is 1879.76 ha, including 80 subcompartments spreading over Sanjiang Town, Dajing Town, Changle Town of Hunan Carbon Technology Co., Ltd.  All these departments are 100% owned by forest farmers and have the legal right to forest ownership. They all singned commissioning contracts with Hunan Carbon Technology Co., Ltd. The species involved in the project are Chinese Fir, Masson pine, Broad-leaf trees and other pine. These are common local tree species.

Prior to the implementation of the project activity, the trees are logged annually according to a valid and verifiable government-approved timber management plan for harvesting the project area. The implementation of the project activity converses the trees to protected forest to reduce the GHG emissions for about 708,630 tCO2e in 30 years, the average annual emission reduction is 23,621 tCO2e and Verified Carbon Units with buffer deduction is about 552,731 tCO2e in 30 years, the average annual VCUs with buffer deduction is 18,424 tCO2e.

The project activity will contribute to the environment (biodiversity conservation and soil erosion control), thus contribute to sustainable development.
